{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=11|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Crisis (2011–present)]]
**The [[Libya]]n [[House of Representatives (Libya)|Tobruk-based government]] has full control of the [[El Sharara oil field]], the largest oilfield in Libya, after it was captured by the [[Libyan National Army]]. The oilfield, which was formerly under the control of [[Tripoli]]-based [[Government of National Accord]], was taken over by local tribesmen in December 2018. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-oil/east-libyan-forces-say-they-have-full-control-of-el-sharara-oilfield-idUSKCN1Q026C (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Mars One]], a private [[Netherlands|Dutch]] organization that had claimed it would send humans on a one-way trip to [[Mars]] starting in [[2024]], releases a statement saying it has been declared bankrupt. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/mars-one-bankrupt-1.5014522 (CBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A helicopter carrying [[Brazil]]ian journalist and [[news anchor]] [[Ricardo Boechat]] crashes in [[São Paulo]], killing both Boechat and the pilot. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47196268 (BBC)] 
*[[2018–19 North American winter]]
**A winter storm is expected to bring up to {{convert|12|in|cm}} of snow to the Midwestern and Northeastern United States in the upcoming days. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/snowstorms-expected-bring-travel-woes-power-issues-midwest-northeast-n969966 (NBC News)]
*[[2019 India alcohol poisoning]]
**At least 99 people die after drinking [[toxic alcohol]] in India's two neighboring states of [[Uttar Pradesh]] and [[Uttarakhand]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/feb/11/toxic-alcohol-methanol-india-uttar-pradesh-uttarakhand (''The Guardian'')]
*A winter storm hits [[Hawaii]], depositing snow at record-low elevations at [[Polipoli Spring State Recreation Area|Polipoli State Park]], along with massive waves, coastal flooding, and strong winds, resulting in at least one death. [https://www.apnews.com/445a98d16498435f8d5a5765c683113a (AP)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2019/02/11/historic-storm-hurls-huge-waves-mph-winds-hawaii-rare-snow-hits-maui/?utm_term=.5321533da927 (''The Washington Post'')]

;International relations
*[[Switzerland–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] and [[Switzerland]] sign a trade continuity agreement to maintain current trade relations post-[[Brexit]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/feb/11/uk-signs-brexit-trade-continuity-deal-with-switzerland (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Oulu child sexual exploitation scandal]]
**Finnish police start to investigate new rapes of two underage girls that had occurred a few days earlier in [[Oulu]], Finland. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/two_new_suspected_cases_of_child_sexual_abuse_in_oulu/10642570 (Yle)]
*A 15-year-old student has stabbed and killed his teacher and a classmate at a high school in [[Stolbtsy]], [[Belarus]]. Two other classmates were also injured. [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/02/11/world/europe/ap-eu-belarus-school-attack-.html (The New York Times)]
